{{Short description|American statistician (born 1941)}}
'''Dean Leroy Isaacson''' (born 1941) is an American statistician.

==Academic career==
After graduating from Milaca High School in [[Milaca, Minnesota]], Isaacson earned a bachelor's degree in mathematics at [[Macalester College]], then completed his master's and doctorate at [[University of Minnesota]].<ref name="mhsprofile">{{cite news |title=Dean L. Isaacson |url=https://www.milaca.k12.mn.us/page/3198/20 |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Milaca High School}}</ref> He joined the [[Iowa State University]] faculty in 1968, and served as chair of the Department of Statistics from 1984 to 2002,<ref name="retire2009"/><ref name="2002chair1">{{cite news |title=Receptions: Dean Isaacson |url=https://archive.inside.iastate.edu/2002/0419/receptions.shtml |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University |date=19 May 2002}}</ref> when he was succeeded in the role by [[Kenneth Koehler]].<ref name="2002isustat">{{cite news |title=KOEHLER WILL DIRECT IOWA STATE'S STATISTICS DEPARTMENT |url=https://www.news.iastate.edu/oldreleases/2002/nov/koehler.shtml |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University |date=6 November 2002}}</ref><ref name="2002calsstat">{{cite news |title=Koehler Named Interim Chair of Department of Statistics |url=https://www.cals.iastate.edu/news/2002/koehler-named-interim-chair-department-statistics |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University College of Agriculture and Life Sciences |date=5 November 2002}}</ref> Isaacson was granted emeritus status upon retirement in 2009.<ref name="isustatsprofile">{{cite news |title=Dean L Isaacson |url=https://www.stat.iastate.edu/people/dean-isaacson |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University Department of Statistics}}</ref><ref name="retire2009">{{cite news |last1=Krapfl |first1=Anne |title=Honoring a previous leader |url=https://archive.inside.iastate.edu/2009/0514/snedecor.shtml |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=Iowa State University |date=14 May 2009}}</ref>

==Honors==
Isaacson is a 1994 fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]].<ref name="asafellowlist">{{cite news |title=ASA Fellows |url=https://ww2.amstat.org/fellows/ |access-date=23 June 2024 |publisher=American Statistical Association}}</ref> In 2013, he was elected to the Milaca High School Hall of Fame.<ref name="hshof2013">{{cite news |title=Isaacson, DeHart to join hall of famers |url=https://www.hometownsource.com/union_times/news/local/isaacson-dehart-to-join-hall-of-famers/article_41552a22-313b-5a1f-8fc8-31ef052f9270.html |access-date=23 June 2024 |work=Union-Times |date=5 September 2013}}</ref>
